and that his father loves him. But suddenly the father stops, picks up 
the boy, lifts him into his arms, embraces him, kisses him and hugs 
him. Then he puts him down again, and they continue walking. It is 
a wonderful thing to be walking along holding your father’s hand; 
but it is an incomparably greater thing to have his arms enfolded 
around you.
